author: NorthEast News Desk
body: One person died and two others were taken to Rhode Island Hospital after a vehicle crashed and caught fire on West Main Road in Middletown early Thursday, police said.
Officers responded at about 1:20 a.m. to the area near Linden Park. Investigators said the vehicle was traveling south when it struck a stone wall and a utility pole, then ignited.

First responders removed the driver and a front-seat passenger and transported both to the hospital. A passenger in the back seat could not be removed and was pronounced dead at the scene, according to NBC 10 WJAR’s report on the police investigation.

Authorities had not released the names of the occupants or the conditions of the two survivors when the report was published. Police also had not announced what may have caused the vehicle to leave the road. The crash remains under investigation. Residents and drivers in the area should follow any temporary traffic controls while investigators and utility crews complete their work near the damaged pole. Further information is expected after notifications and the initial reconstruction are complete.
dek: Police say a southbound vehicle hit a stone wall and utility pole before catching fire near Linden Park early Thursday.
headline: Middletown crash kills back-seat passenger, sends two to hospital
